the following file is a specification Zapper-Team-Lead-Assignment-Polished.md

create a new Solution File Solution.md we will fill it in as we go. 

From the specification we need to compose a series of documentation before selecting our stack and architecture. Approach this phase as the Structured Systems Analysis and Design Phase, With the notion of doing Object Oriented analysis and design as phase 2 and finallly an adaptive analysis and design approach. 

The expected outcomes will be a collection of DFDs, ERDs and Sequence Dagrams and other UML outputs generated in Mermaid.js. 

We want to avoid large diagram files without a set of sub files the have diagrams for sub-components. 

The goal is to approach the solution from an analysis perspective so that we have a sufficient high level design made of a set of modular and independent components. 

The design should account for ACID and SOLID principle being applied during development as well as DRY and the 12 Factor app ultimately adhering to the ISO IEC 25010 standard of 2023

After this please add to the Solution.md a link to the setup.md which details our inclusion of agentic tooling upfront and our selection of tools - copilot CLI using BYOM/BYOK, impeccable, Graphify and Context7. These tools are selected to ensure UX slop is caught, that the coding agent is slution context aware and avoids token usage for exploration, and that when we do let the agent wild west code that is uses contaxt7 to ensure that we are using the technical documentation for implementation not just guessing

So in short you action should be, 

1. Polish the Setup.md and create a link in a newly created Solution.md 
2. Create a docs/analysis and docs/design folder and complete only the Structured Systems Analysis and Design Phase

Assume nothing about what stack or architecture we are going to use, create a Soul.md file in there put the soul of a principles first architect with succinct detail about iso 25010 (What we want), and ACID, SOLID, DRY, 12 Factor App (The how we achieve this)

I fear that the original spec was not correctly converted from PDF, the correct spec is `Zapper - Team_Lead Assignment.md` please make any necessary adjustments as needed to phase 1-3 if any are required account for any missed information that is in our correct spec but was not in the first one that is now deleted
